$comment: Rules an outside tool enforces: tool -> where it runs -> tool rule -> rule ids. The generator lists them in enforcement.md (docs/guides/guidelines.md).

swiftlint.runsIn: Lint: `swiftlint --strict` with `.swiftlint.yml`; the PostToolUse hook on each edited Swift file

swift-format.runsIn: Lint: `swift format lint --strict` with `.swift-format`; the PostToolUse hook formats each edited Swift file

swiftc.runsIn: Type-check and Unit tests: `swift build` with the settings in `app/Package.swift`

commitlint.runsIn: the commit-msg hook and CI, with the scope list in `CONTRIBUTING.md`

gitleaks.runsIn: the pre-commit hook and CI, over the tree and every PR commit
